rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Shri K.C. Venugopal reads the first resolution passed that day: it thanks Rahul Gandhi for his leadership 'as Congress President' and 'applauds his courage, commitment and conviction in stepping down as Congress President'.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the Hindi rendering of the second resolution, Shri Surjewala says the Working Committee decided that Sonia Gandhi should take up the interim post of Congress President until a regular President is elected in an AICC session, and that Sonia Gandhi accepted this request of the Working Committee.
